verdict.rationale: ReelMimic is an AI video-production tool, so translating a finished video with its voice and lip sync carried over is a fair question for it. The pack has no evidence of video translation, voice carry-over or lip sync. The three-language support (docs-12) covers only the app interface, and the Yating/ElevenLabs TTS keys (gh-7) are narration building blocks, not a localization feature, so neither earns credit.
